notes.cost_usd_per_mtco2e: Forestry treatment cost only (the model's ni_f, sign flipped). It varies by accessibility class but not by county, so it is repeated per county for convenience and also listed once under accessibility_classes.
notes.net_income_burial_usd_per_mtco2e: Net income for the burial pathway, which does vary by county because it includes haulage. Positive is revenue.
notes.has_biomass: False means the county was not part of the residue model, not that it holds no biomass.
notes.depth: Null where no 1 km pixel centre falls inside the county.
